name: Dev Aggarwal
title: Founder & CTO
conviction_themes: Low-code AI orchestration unlocks value for non-technical users and global markets
Multilingual/small LLMs (2-10B) are underrated for non-English use cases like Hindi
Startups leading with tech (especially AI tech) rather than customer problems is a mistake

previous_experiences: Co-founded Gooey.AI (low-code AI orchestration platform) starting Oct 2020; reached 200k users, 1M+ AI runs, $1.5M ARR as of Nov 2023.
Founded Dara.Network (alumni/community networking platform) starting Jan 2020.
Built anti-chatgpt open-source JS tool (★129 on GitHub), described as 'antivirus for your mind'.
Studied at Sir M Visvesvaraya Institute of Technology, graduated 2021.
Gave a lightning talk on DSPy at PyCon India.
bio_text: Dev Aggarwal is the Co-Founder & CTO of Gooey.AI, a low-code AI orchestration platform enabling developers and teams to build, share, and measure generative AI workflows across multiple models. Based in Seattle, he is passionate about building abstractions and applying AI for real-world impact in emerging markets, particularly India and Africa. He also co-founded Dara.Network, a community networking platform, and is actively hiring software engineers.
